subject_group: 6.1.10 Vertical/short takeoff and landing air vehicles

versions.text:
Standard: The air vehicle is no worse than Level 2 flying qualities during height captures and maintenance in hover. Method of Compliance: Prior to entering flight test, verify the standard by the following method(s): Analysis.
(1) Conduct analysis of all height captures in hover to evaluate air vehicle capabilities and control margins, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. Test.
  (1) Lab test: Conduct piloted simulation and evaluation to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD-1797, Hover paragraph for each combination of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes. Prior to entering operational test/operations, verify the standard by the above and following method(s): Test.
  (2) Flight test: Conduct flight test to assess flying/handling qualities as specified in MIL-STD- 1797, Hover paragraph for selected combinations of air vehicle states, control modes, and environmental conditions, to include: a. Baseline control system. b. Precision hover modes.
